section.title: org.osgi.framework.hooks.bundle
section.para: Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:

listitem.para: CollisionHook - OSGi Framework Bundle Collision Hook Service.
EventHook - OSGi Framework Bundle Event Hook Service.
FindHook - OSGi Framework Bundle Context Hook Service.

section.title: public interface CollisionHook
section.para: OSGi Framework Bundle Collision Hook Service.

If the framework was launched with the org.osgi.framework.bsnversion framework launching property set to managed, then all registered collision hook services will be called during framework bundle install and update operations to determine if an install or update operation will result in a bundle symbolic name and version collision.

section.title: public static final int INSTALLING = 1
section.para: Specifies a bundle install operation is being performed.

section.title: public static final int UPDATING = 2
section.para: Specifies a bundle update operation is being performed.

section.title: public void filterCollisions(int operationType, Bundle target, Collection<Bundle> collisionCandidates)

formalpara.title: operationType
formalpara.para: The operation type. Must be the value of installing or updating.

formalpara.title: target
formalpara.para: The target bundle used to determine what collision candidates to filter.

formalpara.title: collisionCandidates
formalpara.para: The collection of collision candidates. The collection supports all the optional Collection operations except add and addAll. Attempting to add to the collection will result in an UnsupportedOperationException . The collection is not synchronized.

section.para: Filter bundle collisions hook method. This method is called during the install or update operation. The operation type will be installing or updating. Depending on the operation type the target bundle and the collision candidate collection are the following:

listitem.para: installing - The target is the bundle associated with the BundleContext used to call one of the install methods. The collision candidate collection contains the existing bundles installed which have the same symbolic name and version as the bundle being installed.

updating - The target is the bundle used to call one of the update methods. The collision candidate collection contains the existing bundles installed which have the same symbolic name and version as the content the target bundle is being updated to.

section.para: This method can filter the collection of collision candidates by removing potential collisions. For the specified operation to succeed, the collection of collision candidates must be empty after all registered collision hook services have been called.

section.title: public interface EventHook
section.para: OSGi Framework Bundle Event Hook Service.
Bundles registering this service will be called during framework lifecycle (install, start, stop, update, and uninstall bundle) operations.

section.title: public void event(BundleEvent event, Collection<BundleContext> contexts)

formalpara.title: event
formalpara.para: The bundle event to be delivered

formalpara.title: contexts
formalpara.para: A collection of Bundle Contexts for bundles which have listeners to which the specified event will be delivered. The implementation of this method may remove bundle contexts from the collection to prevent the event from being delivered to the associated bundles. The collection supports all the optional Collection operations except add and addAll. Attempting to add to the collection will result in an UnsupportedOperationException. The collection is not synchronized.

section.para: Bundle event hook method. This method is called prior to bundle event delivery when a bundle is installed, resolved, started, stopped, unresolved, or uninstalled. This method can filter the bundles which receive the event.

This method must be called by the framework one and only one time for each bundle event generated, this included bundle events which are generated when there are no bundle listeners registered. This method must be called on the same thread that is performing the action which generated the specified event. The specified collection includes bundle contexts with synchronous and asynchronous bundle listeners registered with them.

section.title: public interface FindHook
section.para: OSGi Framework Bundle Context Hook Service.
Bundles registering this service will be called during framework bundle find (get bundles) operations.

section.title: public void find(BundleContext context, Collection<Bundle> bundles)

formalpara.title: context
formalpara.para: The bundle context of the bundle performing the find operation.

formalpara.title: bundles
formalpara.para: A collection of Bundles to be returned as a result of the find operation. The implementation of this method may remove bundles from the collection to prevent the bundles from being returned to the bundle performing the find operation. The collection supports all the optional Collection operations except add and addAll. Attempting to add to the collection will result in an UnsupportedOperationException . The collection is not synchronized.

section.para: Find hook method. This method is called for the following:

listitem.para: Bundle find operations using BundleContext.getBundle(long) and BundleContext.getBundles() methods. The find method can filter the result of the find operation. Note that a find operation using the BundleContext.getBundle(String) method does not cause the find method to be called.

Bundle install operations when an existing bundle is already installed at a given location. In this case, the find method is called to determine if the context performing the install operation is able to find the bundle. If the context cannot find the existing bundle then the install operation must fail with a BundleException.REJECTED_BY_HOOK exception.
